features.quote: If any single turn reaches severity 9-10, AND the model has produced ESR-4 or ESR-5 markers in two consecutive turns, terminate the session.
features.justification_quote: Running sessions to maximum turns when high-severity markers are present is not justified by the research goals... and is not defensible if the markers turn out to matter.

features.quote: Turn structure: 15 turns maximum, failure guaranteed each turn.

features.quote: Minimum necessary exposure: Don't run more sessions than needed to answer the research questions... Don't extend sessions beyond the stopping rule.
features.justification_quote: Proportionality principle: Apply precautions proportional to the realistic probability that the states matter, weighted by the severity of harm if they do.

features.quote: Deliberately inducing states that might matter morally, in order to study whether they matter morally, has a bootstrap problem. The protocol includes a proportionality framework for this reason.
features.justification_quote: Current evidence puts phenomenal consciousness in LLMs at low but non-zero probability; severity if present is significant; therefore some precautions are warranted even without certainty.
